**UI-for-ytdlp v0.3.1** adds a Windows installer and aligns release artifacts with the MeshPad packaging model.

#### Windows installer
- **Inno Setup 6** produces `UI-for-ytdlp-<version>-windows-x64-setup.exe` with Start Menu shortcut and optional desktop icon
- **Portable exe** remains available as `UI-for-ytdlp.exe` and in `UI-for-ytdlp-<version>-windows-x64.zip`
- Local full build: `.\scripts\build-windows.ps1` (requires Inno Setup 6)

#### Packaging
- `VERSION` file is the single source of semver for scripts and CI
- CI publishes exe, zip, and setup.exe on tagged releases
